# Arzana (YC P26)

Arzana (YC P26) is a Software Development company. Arzana is a company that provides self-learning AI agents for ERP automation. They offer custom solutions based on shop data and tribal knowledge. They cater to leading industrial companies and industries served tailored to their industry. Arzana (YC P26) employs 6 people. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States, with an office in San Francisco.

Arzana trains custom AI models to automate quoting, order entry, invoicing, and other mundane office work for American manufacturers. We let our customers scale faster without needing to hire more office staff.
